data.name: Description
data.value: Describes the module or the member it annotates: the text that hover and the object browser show for it.

data.name: Description_Text
data.value: The description.

data.name: ModuleDescription
data.value: Describes the module: the text that hover and the object browser show for it.

data.name: ModuleDescription_Text
data.value: The description.

data.name: VariableDescription
data.value: Describes the variable it annotates: the text that hover and the object browser show for it.

data.name: VariableDescription_Text
data.value: The description.

data.name: Folder
data.value: Deprecated. The folder the module is listed under in the Code Explorer of Rubberduck in the VBE.

data.name: Folder_Path
data.value: The folder, its levels separated by dots: "Parent.Child".

data.name: Ignore
data.value: Suppresses the diagnostics it lists in the file, or in the module of the block whose header it is written above.

data.name: Ignore_Codes
data.value: The codes of the diagnostics to suppress: RDC00101.

data.name: IgnoreModule
data.value: Suppresses the diagnostics it lists in its module.

data.name: IgnoreModule_Codes
data.value: The codes of the diagnostics to suppress: RDC00101.

data.name: Obsolete
data.value: Marks the member or the variable as obsolete, so that each use of it is reported.

data.name: Obsolete_Message
data.value: What to use instead, shown with each use.

data.name: Exposed
data.value: Makes the class visible to other projects (VB_Exposed).

data.name: PredeclaredId
data.value: Gives the class a default instance, named after the class (VB_PredeclaredId).

data.name: Interface
data.value: Marks the class as an interface, which other classes implement.

data.name: NoIndent
data.value: Leaves the module as it is written when code is indented.

data.name: DefaultMember
data.value: Makes the member the default member of the class (VB_UserMemId 0).

data.name: Enumerator
data.value: Makes the member the enumerator that a For Each statement uses (VB_UserMemId -4).

data.name: EntryPoint
data.value: Marks the procedure as one that the host calls, such as a macro, so that no code needs to call it.

data.name: EntryPoint_Caller
data.value: What calls it in the host document, such as the name of a shape.

data.name: ExcelHotkey
data.value: Assigns a keyboard shortcut to the macro in Excel (VB_ProcData.VB_Invoke_Func).

data.name: ExcelHotkey_Key
data.value: The key, pressed with Ctrl: "A".

data.name: ModuleAttribute
data.value: Sets an attribute of the module.

data.name: ModuleAttribute_Attribute
data.value: The name of the attribute: VB_Description.

data.name: ModuleAttribute_Values
data.value: The values of the attribute.

data.name: MemberAttribute
data.value: Sets an attribute of the member or the variable.

data.name: MemberAttribute_Attribute
data.value: The name of the attribute: VB_Description.

data.name: MemberAttribute_Values
data.value: The values of the attribute.
